task: Wrap the unguarded ensureOtlpProxy call in OtlpAgentAdapter.processOtlpEvent() in a non-rethrowing try/catch so a daemon start/restart failure no longer propagates to the OTLP hook's exit code.

component_scope.label: S
component_scope.affected: OtlpAgentAdapter.processOtlpEvent (shared base class for all OTLP hook adapters, e.g. claude-code-otlp)

technical_risk.label: XS
technical_risk.mitigation: Mirrors the existing non-rethrowing try/catch + logger pattern already used in the same method for decision.finalize failures (logger.warn '... failed:'); trivially reversible.

key_reasoning.reason: The touched method, OtlpAgentAdapter.processOtlpEvent, is a shared base class used by every OTLP hook adapter (currently claude-code-otlp, documented as the reference implementation for future adapters), so even a single-method change here counts as touching a core shared utility rather than a fully isolated endpoint — bumped from XS to S by red flag.

3 files changed (1 production file, 2 existing test files updated with new coverage), 0 new files, spanning two directories (src/agents/core and src/cli/commands) — squarely in the S band (3-4 modified files).
